_comment: Weights and decay scales for ranking candidate Mapillary panoramas at a location. Mapillary is the only imagery
provider whose candidates we rank ourselves: GSV delegates selection to Google's StreetViewService, and
Two consumers must agree on these numbers, which is why they live here rather than in either one:
MapillaryViewer.#scorePano (public/js/common/pano-viewer/src/MapillaryViewer.js) picks the pano Explore and
Validate display, and score_pano (scripts/check_streets_for_imagery.py) picks the pano whose capture date we
record for a street. If those disagreed, we would report a street as freshly imaged and then never show the
The weights sum to 1, so a score is always in [0, 1]. models.utils.MapillaryPanoScoring parses this into a typed
shape, so a typo fails loudly and this comment never reaches the browser.
